title: On the additive structure of algebraic valuations of polynomial semirings II
summary: For $α\in \mathbb{C}$, let $\mathbb{N}_0[α]$ be the subsemiring of~$\mathbb{C}$ obtained as a homomorphic image of the $α$-evaluation map $\mathbb{N}_0[x] \to \mathbb{C}$ defined as $p(x) \mapsto p(α)$ for each polynomial $p(x) \in \mathbb{N}_0[x]$. Fundamental arithmetic and atomic aspects of the additive structure of $\mathbb{N}_0[α]$ were first studied by the second author and Correa-Morris (2022).
